Adjustment Type.Increment: Add the Adjustment Parameter to the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer, Interval, Date Time, and Date Time Extended. The default is parameter is 1 for numeric types, 1 second for Date Time, and 1 microsecond for Date Time Extended.
Adjustment Type.Decrement: Subtract the Adjustment Parameter to the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer, Interval, Date Time, and Date Time Extended. The default is parameter is 1 for numeric types, 1 second for Date Time, and 1 microsecond for Date Time Extended.
Adjustment Type.Negate: Negate the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer and Boolean types.

Asynchronous Indicator.Mandatory: The server SHALL process all batch items in the request asynchronously (returning an Asynchronous Correlation Value for each batch item).
Asynchronous Indicator.Optional: The server MAY process each batch item in the request either asynchronously (returning an Asynchronous Correlation Value for a batch item) or synchronously. The method or policy by which the server determines whether or not to process an individual batch item asynchronously is a decision of the server and is outside of the scope of this protocol.
Asynchronous Indicator.Prohibited: The server SHALL NOT process any batch item asynchronously. All batch items SHALL be processed synchronously.

Batch Error Continuation Option.Undo: If any operation in the request fails, then the server SHALL undo all the previous operations. Batch item fails and Result Status is set to Operation Failed. Responses to batch items that have already been processed are returned normally. Responses to batch items that have not been processed are not returned.
Batch Error Continuation Option.Stop: If an operation fails, then the server SHALL NOT continue processing subsequent operations in the request. Completed operations SHALL NOT be undone. Batch item fails and Result Status is set to Operation Failed. Responses to other batch items are returned normally.
Batch Error Continuation Option.Continue: Return an error for the failed operation, and continue processing subsequent operations in the request. Batch item fails and Result Status is set to Operation Failed. Batch items that had been processed have been undone and their responses are returned with Undone result status.

Cancellation Result.Canceled: The cancel operation succeeded in canceling the pending operation.
Cancellation Result.Unable to Cancel: The cancel operation is unable to cancel the pending operation.
Cancellation Result.Completed: The pending operation completed successfully before the cancellation operation was able to cancel it.
Cancellation Result.Failed: The pending operation completed with a failure before the cancellation operation was able to cancel it.
Cancellation Result.Unavailable: Unavailable – The specified correlation value did not match any recently pending or completed asynchronous operations.

Client Registration Method.Server Pre-Generated: The server has pre-generated the client’s private key. The returned PKCS#12 is protected with HEX(SHA256(Username || Password)).
Client Registration Method.Server On-Demand: The server generates the client’s private key on demand. The returned PKCS#12 is protected with HEX(SHA256(Username || Password)).
Client Registration Method.Client Generated: The client generates the private key and sends a Certificate Signing Request to the server to generate the certificate. The returned PKCS#12 is protected with HEX(SHA256(Username || Password)).
Client Registration Method.Client Registered: The client generates the private key and the certificates and registers the certificate with the server.

Encoding Option.No Encoding: the wrapped un-encoded value of the Byte String Key Material field in the Key Value structure
Encoding Option.TTLV Encoding: the wrapped TTLV-encoded Key Value structure

Endpoint Role.Client: The endpoint that sends requests and receives responses.
Endpoint Role.Server: The endpoint that receives requests and sends responses.

Item Type.Byte String: Sequences of bytes containing individual unspecified eight-bit binary values
Item Type.Date Time: Eight-byte long (64 bit) POSIX Time values in seconds. .
Item Type.Interval: Four-byte long (32 bit) unsigned numbers in seconds
Item Type.Date Time Extended: Eight-byte long (64 bit) POSIX Time values in micro-seconds.

Key Format Type.Raw: A key that contains only cryptographic key material, encoded as a string of bytes.
Key Format Type.Opaque: an encoded key for which the encoding is unknown to the key management system. It is encoded as a string of bytes.
Key Format Type.PKCS1: an encoded private key, expressed as a DER-encoded ASN.1 PKCS#1 object.
Key Format Type.PKCS8: An encoded private key, expressed as a DER-encoded ASN.1 PKCS#8 object, supporting both the RSAPrivateKey syntax and EncryptedPrivateKey
Key Format Type.X.509: An encoded object, expressed as a DER-encoded ASN.1 X.509 object.
Key Format Type.ECPrivateKey: An ASN.1 encoded elliptic curve private key.
Key Format Type.Several Transparent Key types: algorithm-specific structures containing defined values for the various key types.
Key Format Type.Extensions: Vendor-specific extensions to allow for proprietary or legacy key formats.

Link Type.Private Key Link: For a Public Key object: the private key corresponding to the public key.
Link Type.Public Key Link: For a Private Key object: the public key corresponding to the private key. For a Certificate object: the public key contained in the certificate.
Link Type.Certificate Link: For Certificate objects: the parent certificate for a certificate in a certificate chain. For Public Key objects: the corresponding certificate(s), containing the same public key.
Link Type.Derivation Base Object Link: For a derived Symmetric Key or Secret Data object: the object(s) from which the current symmetric key was derived.
Link Type.Derived Key Link: The symmetric key(s) or Secret Data object(s) that were derived from the current object.
Link Type.Replacement Object Link: For a Symmetric Key, an Asymmetric Private Key, or an Asymmetric Public Key object: the key that resulted from the re-key of the current key. For a Certificate object: the certificate that resulted from the re-certify. Note that there SHALL be only one such replacement object per Managed Object.
Link Type.Replaced Object Link: For a Symmetric Key, an Asymmetric Private Key, or an Asymmetric Public Key object: the key that was re-keyed to obtain the current key. For a Certificate object: the certificate that was re-certified to obtain the current certificate.
Link Type.Parent Link: For all object types: the container or other parent object corresponding to the object.
Link Type.Child Link: For all object types: the subordinate, derived or other child object corresponding to the object.
Link Type.Previous Link: For all object types: the previous object to this object.
Link Type.Next Link: For all object types: the next object to this object.
Link Type.Wrapping Key Link: For wrapped objects: the object that was used to wrap this object.

Result Reason.Application Namespace Not Supported: The particular Application Namespace is not supported, and the server was not able to generate the Application Data field of an Application Specific Information attribute if the field was omitted from the client request
Result Reason.Attestation Failed: Operation requires attestation data and the attestation data provided by the client does not validate
Result Reason.Attestation Required: Operation requires attestation data which was not provided by the client, and the client has set the Attestation Capable indicator to True
Result Reason.Attribute Instance Not Found: A referenced attribute was found, but the specific instance was not found
Result Reason.Attribute Not Found: A referenced attribute was not found at all on an object
Result Reason.Attribute Read Only: Attempt to set a Read Only Attribute
Result Reason.Attribute Single Instance: Attempt to provide multiple values for a single instance attribute
Result Reason.Authentication not successful: The authentication information in the request could not be validated, or was not found
Result Reason.Bad Password: Key Format Type is PKCS#12, but missing or multiple PKCS#12 Password Links, or not Secret Data, or not Active
Result Reason.Codec Error: The low level TTLV, XML, JSON etc. was badly formed and not understood by the server.TTLV connections should be closed as future requests might not be correctly separated
Result Reason.Cryptographic Failure: The operation failed due to a cryptographic error
Result Reason.Encoding Option Error: The Encoding Option is not supported as specified by the Encoding Option Enumeration
Result Reason.Feature Not Supported: The operation is supported, but not a specific feature specified in the request is not supported
Result Reason.General failure: The request failed for a reason other than any other reason enumeration value.
Result Reason.Illegal Object Type: Check cannot be performed on this object type
Result Reason.Incompatible Cryptographic Usage Mask: The cryptographic algorithm or other parameters is not valid for the requested operation
Result Reason.Internal Server Error: The server had an internal error and could not process the request at this time.
Result Reason.Invalid Asynchronous Correlation Value: No outstanding operation with the specified Asynchronous Correlation Value exists
Result Reason.Invalid Attribute: An attribute is invalid for this object for this operation
Result Reason.Invalid Attribute Value: The value supplied for an attribute is invalid
Result Reason.Invalid Data Type: A data type was invalid for the requested operation
Result Reason.Invalid Field: The request is syntactically valid but some data in the request (other than an attribute value) has an invalid value
Result Reason.Invalid Message: The request message was not syntactically understood by the server. For example - the invalid use of a known tag
Result Reason.Invalid Object Type: Specificed object is not valid for the requested operation
Result Reason.Item Not Found: No object with the specified Unique Identifier exists
Result Reason.Key Compression Type Not Supported: The object exists, but the server is unable to provide it in the desired Key Compression Type
Result Reason.Key Format Type Not Supported: The object exists, but the server is unable to provide it in the desired Key Format Type
Result Reason.Key Value Not Present: A meta data only object. The key value is not present on the server
Result Reason.Key Wrap Type Not Supported: Key Wrap Type Type is not supported by the server
Result Reason.Missing data: The operation REQUIRED additional information in the request, which was not present
Result Reason.Missing Initialization Vector: Missing IV when required for crypto operation
Result Reason.Multi Valued Attribute: Attempt to Set or Adjust an attribute that has multiple values
Result Reason.Non Unique Name Attribute: Trying to perform an operation that requests the server to break the constraint on Name attribute being unique
Result Reason.Numeric Range: An operation produced a number that is to large or too small to be stored in the specified data type
Result Reason.Object Already Exists: for operations such as Import that require that no object with a specific unique identifier exists on a server
Result Reason.Object Archived: The object SHALL be recovered from the archive before performing the operation
Result Reason.Object Destroyed: Object exists, but has already been destroyed
Result Reason.Object Not Found: A requested managed object was not found or did not exist
Result Reason.Object Type: Invalid object type for the operation
Result Reason.Operation canceled by requester: The operation was asynchronous, and the operation was canceled by the Cancel operation before it completed successfully
Result Reason.Operation Not Supported: The operation requested by the request message is not supported by the server
Result Reason.Permission Denied: Client is not allowed to perform the specified operation
Result Reason.PKCS#11 Codec Error: There is a Codec error in the Input parameter
Result Reason.PKCS#11 Invalid Function: The PKCS function is not in the interface
Result Reason.PKCS#11 Invalid Interface: The interface is unknown or unavailable in the server
Result Reason.Protection Storage Unavailable, Private: The operation could not be completed with the protections requested (or defaulted).
Result Reason.Read Only Attribute: Attempt to set a Read Only Attribute
Result Reason.Response Too Large: Maximum Response Size has been exceeded
Result Reason.Sensitive: Sensitive keys may not be retrieved unwrapped
Result Reason.Server Limit Exceeded: Some limit on the server such as database size has been exceeded
Result Reason.Unknown Enumeration: An enumerated value is not known by the server
Result Reason.Unknown Message Extension: The server does not support the supplied Message Extension
Result Reason.Unknown Tag: A tag is not known by the server
Result Reason.Unsupported Attribute: Attribute is valid in the specification but unsupported by the Server
Result Reason.Unsupported Cryptographic Parameters: Cryptographic Parameters are valid in the specification but unsupported by the Server
Result Reason.Unsupported Protocol Version: The operation cannot be performed with the provided protocol version
Result Reason.Usage Limit Exceeded: The usage limits or request count has been exceeded
Result Reason.Wrapping Object Destroyed: The object exists, but is destroyed
Result Reason.Wrong Key Lifecycle State: The key lifecycle state is invalid for the operation, for example not Active for an Encrypt operation

Wrapping Method.Encrypt only: encryption using a symmetric key or public key, or authenticated encryption algorithms that use a single key
Wrapping Method.MAC/sign only: either MACing the Key Value with a symmetric key, or signing the Key Value with a private key

Adjustment Type.Increment: Add the Adjustment Parameter to the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer, Interval, Date Time, and Date Time Extended. The default is parameter is 1 for numeric types, 1 second for Date Time, and 1 microsecond for Date Time Extended.
Adjustment Type.Decrement: Subtract the Adjustment Parameter to the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer, Interval, Date Time, and Date Time Extended. The default is parameter is 1 for numeric types, 1 second for Date Time, and 1 microsecond for Date Time Extended.
Adjustment Type.Negate: Negate the value. Applies to Integer, Long Integers, Big Integer and Boolean types.

Asynchronous Indicator.Mandatory: The server SHALL process all batch items in the request asynchronously (returning an Asynchronous Correlation Value for each batch item).
Asynchronous Indicator.Optional: The server MAY process each batch item in the request either asynchronously (returning an Asynchronous Correlation Value for a batch item) or synchronously. The method or policy by which the server determines whether or not to process an individual batch item asynchronously is a decision of the server and is outside of the scope of this protocol.
Asynchronous Indicator.Prohibited: The server SHALL NOT process any batch item asynchronously. All batch items SHALL be processed synchronously.

Batch Error Continuation Option.Undo: If any operation in the request fails, then the server SHALL undo all the previous operations. Batch item fails and Result Status is set to Operation Failed. Responses to batch items that have already been processed are returned normally. Responses to batch items that have not been processed are not returned.
Batch Error Continuation Option.Stop: If an operation fails, then the server SHALL NOT continue processing subsequent operations in the request. Completed operations SHALL NOT be undone. Batch item fails and Result Status is set to Operation Failed. Responses to other batch items are returned normally.
Batch Error Continuation Option.Continue: Return an error for the failed operation, and continue processing subsequent operations in the request. Batch item fails and Result Status is set to Operation Failed. Batch items that had been processed have been undone and their responses are returned with Undone result status.

Cancellation Result.Canceled: The cancel operation succeeded in canceling the pending operation.
Cancellation Result.Unable to Cancel: The cancel operation is unable to cancel the pending operation.
Cancellation Result.Completed: The pending operation completed successfully before the cancellation operation was able to cancel it.
Cancellation Result.Failed: The pending operation completed with a failure before the cancellation operation was able to cancel it.
Cancellation Result.Unavailable: Unavailable – The specified correlation value did not match any recently pending or completed asynchronous operations.

Client Registration Method.Server Pre-Generated: The server has pre-generated the client’s private key. The returned PKCS#12 is protected with HEX(SHA256(Username || Password)).
Client Registration Method.Server On-Demand: The server generates the client’s private key on demand. The returned PKCS#12 is protected with HEX(SHA256(Username || Password)).
Client Registration Method.Client Generated: The client generates the private key and sends a Certificate Signing Request to the server to generate the certificate. The returned PKCS#12 is protected with HEX(SHA256(Username || Password)).
Client Registration Method.Client Registered: The client generates the private key and the certificates and registers the certificate with the server.
